name: Weighted Back Extension
steps: Set the bench pad just below your hip creases, secure your ankles behind the rollers and hug the plate to your chest.
Brace your abdomen and fold forward at the hips until you feel tension in your hamstrings while your back stays steady.
Contract your glutes and lower back smoothly to raise your torso back up until your body forms a straight line.
Pause briefly at neutral alignment before lowering smoothly into the next repetition.
tips: Avoid swinging upward past a straight body line into excessive lumbar hyperextension.
Keep your chin slightly tucked and hug the plate tightly against your sternum throughout.
